about: PLAN.md section 3.1 as globs. scripts/check_ownership.py --all: every tracked file matches exactly one stream. --branch <b>: every file the branch changed (git diff --name-only <merge-base>...<b>) belongs to that branch's stream. The Push-1 mechanical commit (push1-moves.sh) is checked with --all only.
glob_semantics: Paths are repo-relative with '/' separators. '**' matches zero or more whole path segments ('a/**' matches 'a/x' and 'a/x/y'); '*' matches within one segment and never '/'; '?' matches one non-'/' character. No braces: every alternative is listed. A file is owned by a stream when it matches one of the stream's include globs and none of its exclude globs.
branch_stream: A stream branch is rb/<stream>[-<topic>]/<milestone>, e.g. rb/s0/m1, rb/s1-web/m1, rb/s3-physics/m5. The stream is the 's<N>' at the start of the second segment (S<N>); the milestone is the last segment (m1 -> M1, m9-1 -> M9-1). rb/integrate/* and rb/land/* are integration branches, not stream branches.

bootstrap_exceptions.about: Files another stream owns that S0 writes once, in the named milestone, as part of a contract. --branch allows them on S0's branch in that milestone only; from then on the owning stream edits them and S0's signature snapshot test (tests/repo) catches contract drift.
